text.tspan: Mean income per year within the richest decile (before tax), 1968 to 2024
The mean income per year within the richest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Income has been
equivalized
.
